fields.v: Configurations are memory-control methods; no agent or model run. Success metric: accepted/verified reuse or safe abstention per replay/proxy labels; the author states no success criterion (threshold), so for every entry below the quality verdict and the cost verdict are 'no criterion stated by the authors'. Offline replay (2 seeds x 40 events), success / FP / abstention / cumulative reward (Table 6); hot-path (200 cases) success / FP / p95 latency (Table 9). -- Lexical: 50.0% / 17.5% / 0.0% / -70.800; paraphrase R@1 78.1%; hot-path 50.0% / 17.5% / 3.920 µs. -- Static hybrid: 50.0% / 17.5% / 0.0% / -70.800; paraphrase R@1 80.2%; hard negatives FP 75.0%, unsafe injection 100%; hot-path 50.0% / 17.5% / 7.327 µs. -- Static+abstention: 35.0% / 2.5% / 75.0% / -33.350; paraphrase R@1 51.0%; hard negatives FP 0.0%, correct non-injection 100%; hot-path 35.0% / 2.5% / 6.041 µs. -- Full retriever (retrieval experiment only): paraphrase R@1 51.0%, MRR 52.1%; not in replay. -- Epsilon-greedy: 53.8% / 8.7% / 30.0% / -49.818; hot-path 28.0% / 2.5% / 7.213 µs. -- UCB1: 55.0% / 2.5% / 50.0% / -35.865; hot-path 32.0% / 0.5% / 9.510 µs. -- Thompson: 53.7% / 2.5% / 38.8% / -52.315; hard negatives FP 50.0%, correct non-injection 31.2%; hot-path 35.5% / 7.0% / 16.230 µs. -- LinUCB: 37.5% / 10.0% / 50.0% / -76.775; hard negatives FP 75.0%; hot-path 42.0% / 5.5% / 3567.384 µs. -- Risk-sensitive TS: 60.0% / 0.0% / 37.5% / -33.700; hard negatives FP 0.0%, correct non-injection 100%; abstention benchmark (56) correct 57.1%, wrong 42.9%; hot-path 60.0% / 0.0% / 411.821 µs. -- RSCB-MC: 62.5% / 0.0% / 35.0% / -31.740; hard negatives FP 0.0%, correct non-injection 100%; abstention benchmark correct 57.1%, wrong 42.9% (author: over-conservative); hot-path 60.5% / 0.0% / 331.466 µs (mean 267.792 µs). -- Oracle upper bound: 67.5% / 0.0% / 50.0% / -5.900; non-deployable diagnostic. -- Ablations of RSCB-MC (Table 7, FP / correct abstention / cum. reward): no abstention 17.5% / 0.0% / -87.800; no failure-family features 0.0% / 5.0% / -41.740; no entity features 0.0% / 5.0% / -33.495; no contextual bandit 0.0% / 5.0% / -33.700; no risk-sensitive objective 0.0% / 5.0% / -33.820; success and cost not reported for ablations. Context-budget proxy (Table 8, 24 cases): no memory utility 60.8% (best), short hint expected success 74.5% / FP influence 12.0%

fields.v: Smoke-scale evidence only; offline replay is not a causal online evaluation; hot-path labels are proxies; context-budget and dry-run experiments are proxy tasks; single-step bandit does not model delayed multi-turn effects or memory aging; controller over-conservative (wrong abstentions); inherits stale/contradictory memory. Future: full-scale benchmark, live LLM-agent evaluation, calibration, off-policy evaluation, long-horizon modeling
